title: 060-Winter: The Coldest Season (Kış: En Soğuk Mevsim)

sentences.englishText: Winter is one of the four seasons.
It was also named Zemheri in the old language.
sentences.turkishText: Eski dilde Zemheri ismiyle de anılırdı.

sentences.englishText: It consists of December, January, February for the Northern hemisphere.
sentences.turkishText: Kuzey yarım küre için Aralık, Ocak, Şubat aylarından oluşur.

sentences.englishText: This season is the coldest one; temperature falls towards negative, and with this decrease, snow and rainfall increases.
sentences.turkishText: Bu mevsim, mevsimlerin en soğuğu olup hava sıcaklığı eksilere doğru düşer ve bu düşüşle kar ve yağmur yağışı artar.

enrichment.summary: Winter is one of the four seasons. It was also named Zemheri in the old language.
